This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer (.NET/React) – AI Services based in Romania.
 We are seeking an experienced Senior Full Stack Engineer to develop and maintain innovative software solutions supporting the daily operations of hearing clinics, healthcare providers, and hospital networks. In this fully remote role, you will join a product-focused engineering team responsible for the Sales domain, covering quotations, invoicing, insurance claims, and payment workflows. You will take ownership of features throughout their entire lifecycle, from understanding business needs and technical design to implementation, deployment, and production monitoring. Working with modern technologies such as .NET, React, Azure, and AI-powered development tools, you will help build scalable, secure, and reliable applications. You will also contribute to architectural decisions, improve engineering practices, and mentor colleagues in the effective use of AI coding agents. This is an exciting opportunity to combine technical leadership, product thinking, and AI-driven software engineering within an international and collaborative environment.
 Accountabilities
Full Stack Development: Design, develop, deploy, and maintain end-to-end features within the Sales domain, including .NET backend services, event-driven integrations, and React-based frontend applications.
Product Collaboration: Work closely with Product Owners and QA specialists from the discovery stage, helping define functional requirements, clarify specifications, and establish acceptance criteria before development begins.
Technical Analysis and Solution Design: Identify gaps and ambiguities in product specifications, independently resolve technical questions, and collaborate with business stakeholders when clarification is required.
AI-Driven Development: Integrate AI coding agents into the entire software development lifecycle, including planning, architecture, coding, testing, code reviews, and maintenance. Validate AI-generated outputs and maintain human oversight of correctness, security, and data protection.
Software Quality and Reliability: Take ownership of application quality through unit and integration testing, code reviews, performance optimization, security considerations, and observability practices.
Production Ownership: Monitor application performance and usage after deployment, support releases, investigate incidents, and collaborate with product teams to continuously improve delivered features.
Architecture and Technical Improvement: Participate in architectural discussions and technical decision-making with technical leads and architects. Contribute to architecture documentation and proactively address technical debt across Sales workflows.
AI Knowledge Sharing: Mentor fellow engineers and share effective AI development workflows, reusable instructions, validation practices, and tools that improve team productivity.
Product-Oriented Engineering: Understand the business needs of hearing clinics and their users, evaluate alternative technical solutions, and recommend approaches that balance business value, development effort, and long-term maintainability.
Continuous Improvement: Analyze customer feedback, support requests, and product usage data to identify opportunities for improvement and inform future development priorities.
 Requirements
Typically 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record of developing, deploying, and maintaining production-grade applications. Demonstrated skills and practical experience are valued over years of experience alone.
Strong hands-on expertise in C# and modern .NET, particularly .NET 8, ASP.NET Core, Web APIs, and Entity Framework or Entity Framework Core.
Solid understanding of Clean Architecture, software design principles, and maintainable application development.
Strong frontend development experience with React and TypeScript, particularly when building complex business applications.
Practical experience designing, developing, and maintaining microservices-based architectures.
Good understanding of asynchronous communication and event-driven systems, ideally using Azure Service Bus, MassTransit, or comparable messaging and event-processing technologies.
Strong SQL database expertise, including relational data modeling, transactional data management, and database optimization.
Experience with API design, automated testing, debugging, application security, and software quality assurance.
Hands-on experience using AI coding agents as part of everyday software development, including planning, implementation, testing, and code review.
Ability to demonstrate practical AI-assisted development workflows, critically assess AI-generated code, identify potential errors, and recognize situations where AI tools should not be relied upon.
Strong product mindset, with the ability to understand business requirements, contribute to feature definition, and influence technical and product decisions.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with the ability to communicate technical concepts and trade-offs in clear business terms.
Strong collaboration and mentoring abilities, with the confidence to share knowledge and contribute to team-wide engineering improvements.
Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken (B2 level or above).
Nice to have: Experience with Python for AI tooling, experimentation, evaluations, and prototyping.
Additional advantages: Experience building applications using LLM APIs, including prompt engineering, tool integration, and evaluating AI-generated results.
Experience working in regulated industries such as healthcare, medical devices, or financial services, particularly when handling sensitive personal data.
Familiarity with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Kubernetes, and containerized application environments.
Experience developing or improving developer tools, CI/CD pipelines, and AI agent configurations used by other engineers.
 Benefits
Fully Remote Work: Work from anywhere in Europe, with a digital-first approach that supports location flexibility.
Flexible Working Conditions: Enjoy a remote working environment designed to support work-life balance and productivity.
International Projects: Contribute to meaningful software development initiatives across different industries and technological domains.
Continuous Learning: Access opportunities to strengthen your technical expertise and develop new skills through practical experience and ongoing professional development.
Modern Technology Stack: Work with cutting-edge technologies, including .NET 8, React, TypeScript, Microsoft Azure, Kubernetes, and AI-powered development tools.
AI Innovation: Gain hands-on experience integrating AI coding agents and AI services into modern software engineering workflows.
Collaborative Culture: Join a diverse, multicultural, and international team of technology professionals.
Career Development: Opportunity to contribute to technical architecture, influence product decisions, and mentor other engineers.
Full-Time Opportunity: Join an international engineering team in a full-time remote position.
